scope: Selected source assessment; not an exhaustive internet census

references.title: Task Management Dashboard
references.creator: Awsmd
references.observed: Frosted neutral-gray outer shell; white rounded inset rail; dark selected row; restrained circular header actions. The published shot is a static dashboard concept.
references.recognition: Creator verified on original Dribbble page. No independent award or representative user score established for this shot.
references.reuse: Reference geometry in original code; no license to copy the background image, branding or illustration established.
references.hermes: Retain this exact shell reference. Adapt actual chat content inside it; keep new Linear advice subordinate to its visual identity.

references.title: A calmer interface for a product in motion
references.creator: Charlie Aufmann and Maxime Heckel / Linear
references.observed: Before/after examples reduce sidebar prominence, simplify icon treatment and soften separators. The article describes a consistent header system.
references.recognition: Design-team primary case study; independent Reddit discussion includes praise and workflow criticism. Neither establishes universal usability.
references.reuse: Study the hierarchy and comparison method in original Hermes code; do not copy Linear branding or private app source.
references.hermes: Keep conversation dominant, supporting navigation quieter and actions in stable locations.

references.title: Sidebar navigation — Untitled UI
references.creator: Jordan Hughes
references.observed: Expanded and split sidebar examples use consistent icon/text columns, section grouping and clearly selected rows. The Pinterest pin was traced to this original.
references.recognition: Named original designer verified. Likes, followers and reposts are not treated as independent quality ratings.
references.reuse: Visual study only unless a separate asset/component license is verified.
references.hermes: Use as a check on hierarchy and readable collapsed/expanded states while preserving the user's R10 folder design.

references.title: Sidebar Navigation for Brainwave
references.creator: Tran Mau Tri Tam for UI8
references.observed: The original first slide shows full and collapsed dark chat navigation with colored outline icons, a selected row and an external tooltip.
references.recognition: Original creator and UI8 attribution verified. No independent quality score established.
references.reuse: Reference anatomy in original code; commercial kit/assets require their actual license. Do not copy marketing labels or unsupported features.
references.hermes: Useful lineage for chat navigation. This does not resolve the exact identity of the older R10 Pinterest pin.

references.title: Craft / Exclusion Tabs
references.creator: Rauno Freiberg
references.observed: The public craft index contains authored interaction studies. The tab prototype was opened and two selections exercised; no continuous timing capture was made.
references.recognition: Devouring Details has an Awwwards Honorable Mention listing. That is a separate work, not an award for every prototype.
references.reuse: Study behavior; verify any source license before copying code. Do not reuse artwork without permission.
references.hermes: Use interruption, selection continuity and bounded state changes as review criteria rather than adding every showcased effect.

references.title: Train Your Judgement
references.creator: Emil Kowalski
references.observed: The page presents paired examples for popovers, interruptions, frequency of use and other choices. Both popover variants were opened in this research.
references.recognition: Named practitioner's authored tutorial; no independent aggregate review score established.
references.reuse: Apply the demonstrated evaluation method and independently authored implementation; do not redistribute the lesson.
references.hermes: Review rapid reversal, press scale, transform origin and frequently used controls at normal speed. Do not require motion where instant feedback is better.

references.title: Lusion Labs, 2023 published reference
references.creator: Lusion
references.observed: The archival frame uses a minimal top bar, small grid/list switch, strong typographic scale and large experiment previews. The current Labs page remained blank after one reload here.
references.recognition: Awwwards Site of the Day listing and Lusion's award profile identify Labs. The live page's present motion was not verified.
references.reuse: Study composition; no Lusion footage, textures, artwork or logo copied into Hermes.
references.hermes: Keep supporting chrome sparse and let useful content carry visual weight. Do not import the landing-page headline scale or full-screen 3D background.

references.title: Lusion v3
references.creator: Lusion
references.observed: CSS Design Awards records Website of the Year 2023 and a final judge score of 9.27 for Lusion v3.
references.recognition: Verified dated jury award. This is not a score for the different current 2026 homepage.
references.reuse: Use as an external benchmark, not an assertion that its proprietary internals were inspected.
references.hermes: A high bar for integrated craft; actual Hermes motion and GPU cost still need their own measurements.

references.title: Things 3
references.creator: Cultured Code
references.observed: The product page's app imagery shows a clear task hierarchy and purposeful category icons; this research did not operate the native app.
references.recognition: Things 3 appears in Apple's 2017 Design Award winners. The vendor also curates testimonials, which are not independent fresh reviews.
references.reuse: Study information hierarchy; no icon pack or screenshots licensed for use in Hermes.
references.hermes: Use readable task names, stable task state and uncluttered project grouping inside the required Rare UI task list.

references.title: Behind the Design: Flighty
references.creator: Flighty / Ryan Jones; Apple editorial
references.observed: Apple's case study illustrates compact, always-available travel state and describes adapting the display when connectivity changes. The native app was not operated.
references.recognition: Apple Design Award winner for Interaction, 2023.
references.reuse: Study state prioritization; no app artwork or flight data reused.
references.hermes: Keep truthful loading, approval, running, cancelling and error states understandable in compact status surfaces.

references.title: Raycast navigation
references.creator: Raycast
references.observed: The navigation manual documents keyboard-oriented search and action access. No installed Raycast app was operated.
references.recognition: The product homepage lists curated endorsements. No representative independent score was verified in this study.
references.reuse: Apply interaction conventions in original code; do not copy branding or product illustrations.
references.hermes: One compact plus/action menu with searchable supported commands, keyboard hints, explicit disabled reasons and predictable focus return.

references.title: Paper Shaders: Liquid Metal
references.creator: Paper Design
references.observed: The documented effect supports contour, distortion, dispersion and bounded pixel processing. The canvas did not render here, so live material motion is unverified.
references.recognition: Source availability and a named maintainer are established; visual quality and GPU performance on Mani's PC are not.
references.reuse: Pinned upstream Apache-2.0 source and NOTICE are recorded. Older forks show different licensing; do not mix them.
references.hermes: Prototype only a small upload surface, compare to the exact Inspora clip, and measure cost during local inference. It is not proof of the original clip's technique.

references.title: Native macOS AI Chat App Concept
references.creator: Tran Mau Tri Tam
references.observed: Rounded translucent chat panels include decorative model/provider imagery and a fictional 3D-render workflow.
references.recognition: Creator-attributed concept. Neither production behavior nor aggregate quality was established.
references.reuse: No copying of embedded character art, logos or generated-output imagery; provenance and rights are unverified.
references.hermes: Do not adopt this as a replacement design. Its decorative provider branding and unsupported output workflow conflict with the user's brief.

references.title: Motion Primitives
references.creator: ibelick
references.observed: The documented morphing popover transitions between trigger and content. Direct page retrieval was limited; no production accessibility claim is made.
references.recognition: GitHub adoption snapshot recorded separately; stars are not reviews of a particular component.
references.reuse: Pinned MIT license; inspect the actual component and current issues before any reuse.
references.hermes: Optional bounded morph behavior where appropriate. Files/Details/Settings must retain stable hit targets and semantic popover behavior.

references.title: Magic UI
references.creator: Magic UI contributors
references.observed: The site distinguishes open-source animated components from Pro products.
references.recognition: GitHub adoption snapshot, not a human-review guarantee.
references.reuse: The pinned repository is MIT; this does not cover paid templates, unrelated assets or every third-party dependency.
references.hermes: Reuse an applicable implementation only after source review. Do not turn the chat app into a collection of landing-page effects.

references.title: Uiverse
references.creator: Uiverse community
references.observed: Community component listings link to their creators and code.
references.recognition: Repository adoption is recorded; no blanket quality, provenance or performance endorsement.
references.reuse: Pinned Galaxy repository MIT license verified. Check the exact selected item and external assets separately.
references.hermes: Inspect individual creator submissions only when a real component gap remains.

references.title: Responsive pinned sidebar with popover
references.creator: Jhey (jh3y), via FreeFrontend
references.observed: FreeFrontend's sidebar example resolves to Jhey's original pen; the source is a technical demonstration, not a user-tested Hermes solution.
references.recognition: Creator trace verified; no independent review score established.
references.reuse: Verify pen license before copying; an independent implementation can study the interaction.
references.hermes: Useful for responsive popover mechanics; browser support and stable geometry require actual tests.

references.title: Geist Design System
references.creator: Vercel
references.observed: Official design-system references cover colors, icons and components for consistent interfaces.
references.recognition: Primary product-system documentation; no external usability score asserted.
references.reuse: Consult applicable asset/component licensing before reuse.
references.hermes: Use consistent semantic tokens and icon treatment; preserve the user's specific visual direction.

references.title: Zed tool permissions
references.creator: Zed
references.observed: The documentation separates automatic tool execution from confirmation rules and documents current configuration changes.
references.recognition: Functional primary documentation, not a visual-quality rating.
references.reuse: Apply the behavioral distinction; do not import Zed settings or imply Hermes has its enforcement.
references.hermes: Make action approval scope visible and enforce it in the actual Hermes server/dispatcher. The v4 policy remains authoritative.
